item.title: Donegal ETB Training Centre reopened after minor fire
item.description: The Donegal ETB Training Centre building in Letterkenny has reopened this evening following a minor fire to the exterior of the building. Emergency services were called after an extractor fan caught alight. A spokesperson form the ETB says the building temporarily closed as a precaution and that there were no injuries.
